title: EVAC LAYER site (data/sites/<id>.json)
description: One installed screen. Its coordinates and facing decide the shelter, direction and distance on every screen made for it. The file name is <id>.json. Several sites may share a municipality.

municipality_id.description: JIS municipality code of the place the screen stands in.

facing_deg.description: Compass bearing the viewer faces while reading the screen (0 = north).

replay.description: Demo only: the site replays a recorded feed instead of following data/live/<id>.json.

municipality.description: Recording to replay when it is not the site's own municipality.
